canonical.name: Strength and muscular capability
canonical.scope: Train major movement patterns progressively with sound technique and recovery.
canonical.evidence_of_progress: Demonstrates measurable strength improvement without avoidable injury.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

canonical.professional_boundary: Health and exercise content must be adapted to the person and does not replace licensed medical care.

historical_source: before.json and recovered-repair-source.json preserve the pre-repair source; neither is current acceptance
limits: Original educational exercise; no medical clearance, universal prescription, or causal efficacy claim
